title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 19): C0CK Carrousel
summary: Part 19 of his mocking series on YouTuber Jason Blaha, centred on a speculative, insult-heavy argument that Blaha is a closeted gay man who projects by calling others gay. He also recounts the history of the anti-Blaha forum (the MISC), its infighting, the Craigslist harassment campaign, and why he refuses to share his sources.
claims: He believes removing the public dislike count hurt hate-watched channels like Blaha's, because the hate-watching traffic that gave them views disappeared
Buying fake subscribers kills a channel's reach because subscribers who never watch weaken its standing in the algorithm
He claims his series drove most of Blaha's teenage coaching clients away; the remaining adults pay about $250 a month to a coach with no competitive title
Calling bodybuilding gay because men flex on stage says more about the accuser; posing on stage is not sexual for the competitors
He mocks Blaha for never sweating on camera, attributing it to never doing high reps or training hard enough to get out of breath
Blaha's endless cuts show he cares about aesthetics despite mocking bodybuilding; cut he looks emaciated, bulked he looks obese
Most of the episode is a deliberately insulting, speculative case that Blaha is closeted, built on old forum posts and photos; NH concedes it is only a theory
The MISC forum once coordinated archiving and exposing Blaha, but split over a member's in-person harassment campaign and collapsed into infighting
Groups united against a single target tend to turn on each other once the target weakens and there is nothing left to do
He no longer shares screenshots or sources because remnants of the MISC used previously shared sources to try to dox him
Blaha believes a 700 lb deadlift will make him happy, but no lift, cut or bulk will fix an unhappy life
